skill.name: hig-project-context
skill.description: Create or update a shared Apple design context document that other HIG skills use to tailor guidance.
skill.summary: Build a reusable Apple design context from project files and confirmed user requirements.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Repeated discovery questions slow Apple design reviews and create inconsistent guidance. This skill builds a shared context document from project evidence and confirmed requirements.
actual_capabilities: Reviews project documentation, configuration, code imports, assets, and accessibility usage for relevant context.
Identifies supported Apple platforms, minimum operating systems, frameworks, architecture, and Apple technologies.
Collects product, design system, accessibility, user, and existing asset requirements.
Presents discovered information for user confirmation before completing missing details.
Creates or selectively updates `.claude/apple-design-context.md` with a consistent structure.
limitations: It depends on available project files and accurate user confirmation.
It does not validate interface quality or guarantee Apple HIG compliance.
It does not replace accessibility testing, legal review, or device testing.
It updates only the shared context document and does not modify application code.

use_cases.title: Start a New Apple App
use_cases.description: Capture platform, framework, design, accessibility, and user decisions before detailed interface work begins.

use_cases.title: Document an Existing Codebase
use_cases.description: Extract verified design context from project files so future HIG guidance reflects the current implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Design Review
use_cases.description: Consolidate product constraints and accessibility goals before reviewing patterns, components, or platform conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the Apple design context for this project. Review available files, show your findings, and ask me to confirm missing details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a project has no shared Apple design context.

prompt_templates.title: Update Existing Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing Apple design context and update only the sections affected by these changes: [describe changes].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after product, platform, or design requirements change.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Accessibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Build or update the project context with emphasis on accessibility goals, current implementation evidence, user needs, and regulatory requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before an accessibility-focused design review.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Context with Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the current Apple design context with project files. Identify conflicts, request confirmation, and revise only verified sections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when documentation may no longer match the implementation.

output_examples.input: Create context for our SwiftUI iPhone app and identify missing information.
output: Discovered: SwiftUI interface, iOS target, dark mode color assets, and accessibility labels.
Confirmation needed: minimum iOS version, primary persona, Dynamic Type status, and target accessibility level.
Next step: confirm these findings before the context document is generated.

output_examples.input: Update the context because the app now supports iPadOS and multi-window workflows.
output_examples.output: The Platforms and Technology sections are updated for iPadOS and multi-window support. All unrelated product, design, and accessibility details remain unchanged.

output_examples.input: Check whether our project context still matches the repository.
output: Confirmed: SwiftUI, CloudKit, iOS, and iPadOS remain consistent with project evidence.
Conflict found: the context lists no dark mode support, but the asset catalog contains dark variants.
Confirmation requested before changing the Design System section.

best_practices: Confirm discovered facts before writing or changing the shared context document.
Record concrete platform versions, frameworks, accessibility goals, and user environments.
Update only changed sections and preserve verified information.
anti_patterns: Do not assume requirements that project files and the user have not confirmed.
Do not replace the entire context document when only one section changed.
Do not treat the context document as proof of HIG or accessibility compliance.

faq.question: What file does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates or updates `.claude/apple-design-context.md` in the project.

faq.question: Which Apple platforms can it document?
faq.answer: It covers iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS.

faq.question: Does it inspect existing project files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review documentation, project configuration, code imports, property lists, assets, and accessibility usage.

faq.question: Will it overwrite existing context?
faq.answer: It should update only changed sections and preserve unchanged information.

faq.question: Does it guarantee Apple HIG compliance?
faq.answer: No. It records context for tailored guidance but does not replace design review or testing.

faq.question: Can it support accessibility planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It records accessibility targets, implementation evidence, user considerations, and applicable regulatory requirements.
